edges.note: IRC-verified elementary step: TS1 connects the cZc reactive conformer minimum (reverse IRC endpoint, C1...C6 3.23 A) to 1,3-cyclohexadiene (forward IRC endpoint, C1-C6 1.56 A). Barrier = E(TS1) - E(RC_cZc) = 18.99 kcal/mol.

Same elementary step referenced to the lowest-energy verified minimum of the reactant state (tZt global minimum, 9.29 kcal/mol below the cZc conformer): E(TS1) - E(RC) = 28.28 kcal/mol. This is the effective (observable) barrier at 390-434 K because the conformational pre-equilibrium is fast.
